ayahs.1: (Tamaam cheezen) jo aasmanon aur zameen mein hain Allah ki paaki bayan karti hain, isi ki saltanat hai aur isi ki tareef hai, aur woh har cheez par qaadir hai.
ayahs.2: Usi ne tumhein paida kiya hai so tum mein se baaze to kaafir hain aur baaze imaan wale hain, aur jo kuchh tum kar rahe ho Allah Taala khoob dekh raha hai.
ayahs.3: Usi ne aasmanon ko aur zameen ko adl-o-hikmat se paida kiya, isi ne tumhari sooraten banaayen aur bahut achchhi banaayen aur isi ki taraf lautna hai.
ayahs.4: Woh aasman-o-zameen ki har har cheez ka ilm rakhta hai aur jo kuchh tum chhupaao aur jo zaahir karo woh (sab ko) jaanta hai. Allah to seenon ki baaton tak ko jaanne wala hai.
ayahs.5: Kya tumhare paas is se pehle ke kaafiron ki khabar nahin pahunchi? Jinhon ne apne aamaal ka wabaal chakh liya aur jin ke liye dardnaak azaab hai.
ayahs.6: Yeh is liye ke un ke paas un ke Rasool waazeh dalaail le kar aaye to unhon ne keh diya ke kya insaan hamari rehnumaai karega? Pas inkaar kar diya aur munh pher liya aur Allah ne bhi be-niyaazi ki, aur Allah to hai hi bahut be-niyaaz sab khoobiyon wala.
ayahs.7: Un kaafiron ne khayaal kiya hai ke dobaara zinda na kiye jaayenge. Aap keh dijiye ke kyun nahin Allah ki qasam! Tum zaroor dobaara uthaaye jaaoge phir jo tum ne kiya hai is ki khabar diye jaaoge aur Allah par yeh bilkul hi aasaan hai.
ayahs.8: So tum Allah par aur us ke Rasool par aur is noor par jise hum ne naazil farmaaya hai imaan laao aur Allah Taala tumhare har amal par ba-khabar hai.
ayahs.9: Jis din tum sab ko is jama hone ke din jama karega wohi din hai haar jeet ka aur jo shakhs Allah par imaan la kar nek amal kare Allah is se is ki buraaiyan door kar dega aur ise jannaton mein daakhil karega jin ke neeche nehrein beh rahi hain jin mein woh hamesha hamesha rahenge. Yehi bahut badi kaamyaabi hai.
ayahs.10: Aur jin logon ne kufr kiya aur hamari aayaton ko jhutlaaya wohi (sab) jahannami hain (jo) jahannam mein hamesha rahenge, woh bahut bura thikaana hai.
ayahs.11: Koi museebat Allah ki ijaazat ke baghair nahin pahunch sakti, jo Allah par imaan laaye Allah is ke dil ko hidayat deta hai aur Allah har cheez ko khoob jaanne wala hai.
ayahs.12: (Logo) Allah ka kehna maano aur Rasool ka kehna maano. Pas agar tum iraaz karo to hamare Rasool ke zimme sirf saaf saaf pahuncha dena hai.
ayahs.13: Allah ke siwa koi mabood-e-bar-haq nahin aur mominon ko Allah hi par tawakkul rakhna chaahiye.
ayahs.14: Ae imaan walo! Tumhari baaze biwiyan aur baaze bachche tumhare dushman hain pas un se hoshyaar rehna aur agar tum maaf kar do aur darguzar kar jaao aur bakhsh do to Allah Taala bakhshne wala mehrban hai.
ayahs.15: Tumhare maal aur aulaad to sarasar tumhari aazmaaish hain. Aur bahut bada ajr Allah ke paas hai.
ayahs.16: Pas jahan tak tum se ho sake Allah se darte raho aur sunte aur maante chale jaao aur Allah ki raah mein khairaat karte raho jo tumhare liye behtar hai aur jo shakhs apne nafs ki hirs se mehfooz rakha jaaye wohi kaamyaab hai.
ayahs.17: Agar tum Allah ko achchha qarz doge (yaani is ki raah mein kharch karoge) to woh ise tumhare liye badhaata jaayega aur tumhare gunaah bhi maaf farma dega. Allah bada qadr-daan bada burdbaar hai.
ayahs.18: Woh posheeda aur zaahir ka jaanne wala hai zabardast hikmat wala (hai).
